description: This file defines a Java interface 'Counter' for a metric instrument that functions as a gauge which can only be incremented, with methods to increment the counter and retrieve its current value.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: A counter metric is a gauge which can only be incremented, providing methods to increment and retrieve its current count.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the value of the counter by one.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the value of the counter by one for the specified number of times.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the current count of the counter.
